open.note: 6 packets in order. opens a window (tested live)

opens a window (tested live)

Full-screen Texas Hold'em board (CONQUER POKER table, seat [MeGa]mohamed, 100,000 chips, Rebuy/Addon/Leave; the game window switched to 1024x768). 'close' packets verified: board left, client back to the world and shows its TOURNAMENTS (Today's Tournaments) list window.
